metaTitle: Custom Flame Resistant Table Displays | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom flame resistant table displays for trade shows. Durable, safe, and branded to meet event fire codes. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Flame resistant table displays are a must for trade shows, conferences, and hospitality events where fire safety codes apply. Unlike standard polyester throws, these fabrics are treated or inherently flame retardant to reduce ignition risk. Perfect for venues requiring NFPA compliance, options like the 6' Standard Table Throw with full-color front panel let you showcase your brand while meeting strict safety standards. Choose from runners or full throws in round and rectangular sizes to fit any booth setup.
heroAltText: Custom flame resistant table displays featuring a full-color printed 6-foot table throw at a trade show booth.
